results.question: 每个品类的成交总金额分别是多少？成交金额按明细数量乘以成交单价计算。
results.gold_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id
results.pred_sql:
SELECT
    c.name AS category_name,
    COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 0) AS total_transaction_amount
FROM categories AS c
LEFT JOIN products AS p
    ON p.category_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi
    ON oi.product_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN orders AS o
    ON o.id = oi.order_id
   AND o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY c.id
results.executed_sql: SELECT c.name AS category_name, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 0) AS total_transaction_amount FROM categories AS c LEFT JOIN products AS p ON p.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON o.id = oi.order_id AND o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY c.id LIMIT 200

FROM order_quantities

results.question: 2025年上半年（1月到6月）每个月的支付总金额是多少？按月份排列。
results.gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', paid_at) AS month, SUM(amount) FROM payments WHERE paid_at >= '2025-01-01' AND paid_at <= '2025-06-30' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
results.pred_sql:
WITH months(month_num) AS (
    VALUES ('01'), ('02'), ('03'), ('04'), ('05'), ('06')
)
SELECT
    '2025-' || month_num AS month,
    COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) AS total_payment_amount
FROM months
LEFT JOIN payments AS p
    ON strftime('%Y-%m', p.paid_at) = '2025-' || month_num
GROUP BY month_num
ORDER BY month_num
results.executed_sql: WITH months(month_num) AS (SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('01'), ('02'), ('03'), ('04'), ('05'), ('06')) AS _values) SELECT '2025-' || month_num AS month, COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) AS total_payment_amount FROM months LEFT JOIN payments AS p ON STRFTIME('%Y-%m', p.paid_at) = '2025-' || month_num GROUP BY month_num ORDER BY month_num LIMIT 200

results.question: 按毛利（成交单价减去成本，再乘以数量）计算，毛利最高的品类是哪个？给出品类名和毛利。
results.gold_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM((oi.unit_price - p.cost) * oi.quantity) AS profit FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY profit DESC LIMIT 1
results.pred_sql:
SELECT
    c.name AS category_name,
    SUM((oi.unit_price - p.cost) * oi.quantity) AS gross_profit
FROM order_items AS oi
JOIN orders AS o
    ON o.id = oi.order_id
JOIN products AS p
    ON p.id = oi.product_id
JOIN categories AS c
    ON c.id = p.category_id
WHERE o.status IN ('completed', 'shipped')
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY gross_profit DESC
LIMIT 1
results.executed_sql: SELECT c.name AS category_name, SUM((oi.unit_price - p.cost) * oi.quantity) AS gross_profit FROM order_items AS oi JOIN orders AS o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN categories AS c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE o.status IN ('completed', 'shipped') GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY gross_profit DESC LIMIT 1
